answer: Whisper-relay bond taxes fake identities with relays. Each identity carries a lotus-sealed packet from the grove board through three hops per epoch, each signed by a new relay at a jetty checkpoint. Auditors replay signatures; missed hops burn the 70-credit bond. A rented relay signing two packets burns both bonds. Forging 1,000 identities costs 45,000 against a 40,000 pool: a net loss. One honest agent pays 45 once and keeps its bond.
